notes.title: Major Update for the steam Next Fest!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

We are pleased to announce that we have released a very important update to Swappy World!
As you can see, we have changed the cover and in the new version you will find:

[list]
[*] The main menu
[*] The game options
[*] The language selection (at the moment there are only 3, but soon all other languages will be added)
[*] The possibility to save and resume the game (saves are automatic when sleeping)
[*] A gripping Boss Fight that catapults you into the heart of the game's lore!
[*] Lots of bug fixes
[*] Lots of aesthetic improvements that you will notice immediately!
[/list]

To celebrate Steam Next Fest, we've decided to take part in live streaming broadcasts to show gameplays made by us!

We would like to take this opportunity to update you on what we will be introducing next in the game:
[list]
[*] Building a house
[*] Tame a horse (or maybe a monster?) and ride it
[*] Build a farm to grow crops
[*] Explore up to 12 different biomes!
[*] ... and above all take advantage of an improved combat system full of new features!
[/list]

Don't forget to join the official discord:

A loving hug!
Awakening Team
